content.user_title: Build Looker Studio Dashboards with BigQuery
content.value_statement: BigQuery dashboards can become slow, costly, and hard to govern. This skill helps create Looker Studio data sources, SQL models, filters, layouts, and access controls.
actual_capabilities: Guides BigQuery project, dataset, table, and API setup for Looker Studio.
Provides SQL patterns for summaries, joins, cohorts, and filtered reports.
Recommends scheduled queries, partition filters, caching, and chart limits for performance.
Defines dashboard layouts with KPI tiles, trend charts, tables, maps, and filters.
Covers BigQuery and Looker Studio access controls, including viewer roles and row-level security.
Outlines Community Connector configuration using Google Apps Script concepts.
limitations: Does not connect to Google Cloud or Looker Studio without user credentials and permissions.
Does not validate real dataset schemas, billing limits, or organization IAM policies automatically.
Example SQL uses placeholder project and table names that must be replaced.
Community Connector guidance is illustrative and not a complete deployable connector.

use_cases.title: Create an executive analytics dashboard
use_cases.description: Plan KPIs, charts, filters, and BigQuery summary tables for a business reporting dashboard.

use_cases.title: Improve dashboard performance and cost
use_cases.description: Replace slow live queries with partitioned SQL, scheduled summaries, and cache-aware data sources.

use_cases.title: Govern shared reporting access
use_cases.description: Map viewer permissions, data source roles, and row-level security for team dashboards.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a basic dashboard
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup for a new Looker Studio report.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a Looker Studio dashboard plan for my BigQuery table. Include KPIs, charts, filters, and required permissions.

prompt_templates.title: Design an optimized data source
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate work on query cost and loading speed.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my dashboard data needs and propose BigQuery summary tables, scheduled queries, partitions, and cache settings.

prompt_templates.title: Add filters and governance
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced dashboard sharing with controlled access.
prompt_templates.prompt: Design Looker Studio filters, BigQuery roles, and row-level security for a dashboard shared across several teams.

prompt_templates.title: Plan an advanced connector workflow
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced integration planning for custom data access.
prompt_templates.prompt: Outline a Community Connector approach for BigQuery reporting, including configuration fields, caching, billing, and security boundaries.

output_examples.input: I need a weekly ecommerce dashboard for revenue, orders, conversion, and countries.
output_examples.output: A dashboard plan with KPI scorecards, a weekly trend chart, country filters, and a scheduled BigQuery summary table.

output_examples.input: My Looker Studio report is slow because it reads a large events table.
output_examples.output: A performance plan using partition filters, nightly aggregate tables, fewer charts per page, and cache-friendly data sources.

output_examples.input: Only regional managers should see their country data.
output_examples.output: An access plan covering BigQuery viewer roles, row-level security, data source permissions, and Looker Studio sharing settings.

best_practices: Use scheduled BigQuery summaries for large or repeated dashboard queries.
Include a date range filter and use partition columns directly.
Separate dashboard sharing permissions from BigQuery data access permissions.
anti_patterns: Do not connect dashboards directly to very large raw event tables.
Do not place more than 25 charts on one dashboard page.
Do not use broad viewer access when row-level controls are required.

faq.question: Does this skill create dashboards automatically?
faq.answer: It provides plans, SQL patterns, checklists, and configuration guidance. Users still apply changes in Google Cloud and Looker Studio.

faq.question: Can it reduce BigQuery query costs?
faq.answer: Yes. It recommends scheduled summaries, partition filters, caching, and fewer live queries.

faq.question: Does it require Google Cloud credentials?
faq.answer: Credentials are required only when the user applies the recommended Google Cloud or Looker Studio configuration.

faq.question: Can it help with row-level security?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes BigQuery row-level security and Looker Studio sharing guidance.

faq.question: Is the sample SQL ready for production?
faq.answer: No. Replace placeholder project, dataset, table, and user values before use.

faq.question: Which AI coding tools can use it?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
